summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1b in Infectum-wa (63/28)

data.turoyo: Babi i naqqa d əzzawayle li taǧara, u ʕamo mḥayṣalwo bam mo qərš w tre w tloṯo. Babi u maḥṣulayḏe howewa w qərš qərš. Mḥayṣalwo kallat ġalabe.
data.translation: Wenn mein Vater ins Geschäft ging, so verdienten die anderen Leute auf hundert Groschen einen, zwei oder drei; mein Vater aber verdiente einen Groschen auf einen Groschen, er verdiente sehr viel Geld.

data.translation: The people used to work, they used to weave, they used to weave the bags, for three or four lira a day; they would barely obtain that.

rationale: Supports round-1 1b in Infectum-wa with explicit daily wage and occupation. Jan translation is project machine translation, quoted verbatim; analysis rests on Turoyo.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.8/321)

data.turoyo: U mede d mḥayṣəliwo b iḏayye, mbeliwole. Naqqawoṯo mbeliwo u salo kule ste mahzəmiwole. Kafno rabo, ġalabe hawiwo. Hayo kuḏaʕno, hayo maṭinola.
data.translation: Whatever came into their hands, they would take it. Sometimes they would take the whole basket too and carry it off. There had been a great famine, a very great one. That I know; that I lived through.

rationale: Second sense-1 Infectum-wa example after round 1; obtaining food with b iḏayye and an open relative. Jan translation is project machine translation, quoted verbatim; analysis rests on Turoyo.

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Lə kuḏəʕ, u medano lə ḥzeli. U medano lə šaməʕne w lo ḥzeli. Balki maḥkalle. Bas ḥa kayiso we. Mard we. Bi dukṯo, d ḥuḏ̣arwo, lə ṭurewo nošo b qaḥwe wa, b loqanta wa flan, lə ṭurewo nošo, d obe kallat. huwe ubewo. Mḥayṣewole əšmo kayiso.
data.translation: Khori Brahim: I do not know; I did not see that. I have not heard that or seen it. Perhaps they tell it. But he was a good man. He was generous. Wherever he was present, he would not let anyone, whether it was a café or a restaurant and so on, he would not let anyone give money. He used to give it. He had acquired a good little amount.

rationale: New Preterit-wa box; acquisition before the generosity narrative, without assuming explicit wage earning. Jan translation is project machine translation, quoted verbatim; analysis rests on Turoyo.

summary: Preserve the glossary’s stem I label and mḥayṣele/mḥayṣəl base forms. Morphological comments calling the root quadriliteral or Arabic stem II do not authorize relabelling this entry Q or II, and ḥṣl is a separate entry.

The existing single sense expressly includes treffen; projectile impact at JTM 5.3/47, PrS 18/51 and PrS 39/24 therefore needs no new sense. Capture and successful acquisition are broader than arresting persons.
Infectum mḥayṣele with object -le at 57/227 contrasts with homographic Preterit carrying agent -le. Suffix function and clause sequence are decisive; -le alone is not enough to assign a box.
MAC MuA Quzko/5 and 63/28 establish Infectum-wa: repeated hunting and commercial earnings. mḥayṣliwa has plural subject ending -i before -wa, while mḥayṣalwo has collective/3sg subject and -wo.

Detransitive gmiḥayṣəl at 69/123 suppresses the catcher and expresses where someone can be caught. Preserve its existing place under sense 1 rather than introducing an unsupported new Detransitive meaning.
Contact: the inherited Arabic etymology remains tentative (???). These lexical occurrences are not light-verb constructions; they do not independently establish a borrowing history.

Aborted mḥay... in Lahdo Traitor 2/67 is a repair before full mḥayṣele, not a separately classifiable finished form. Its edition translation also continues beyond the supplied verse, so no capture quotation is selected there.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce English is project machine translation, not an edition translation. All semantic decisions rest on the supplied Turoyo; retained English quotations are verbatim machine translation. Only round-2 changes are encoded here.
Retain stem I mḥayṣele/mḥayṣəl and the tentative inherited etymology. No Jan occurrence authorises a new stem Q or merger with ḥṣl.

Round-1 Infectum-wa already has both acquisition and earning examples. Jan habitual wage, trade and electoral contexts support that box; only Preterit-wa Mḥayṣewole at Jan 2.7/1855 is added as a new finite box.

Nominal ḥəyṣolo at Jan 1.2/24 gives context to the inherited bare ḥiṣolo. Its obtaining meaning is agent-oriented despite inherited Detransitive Infinitiv placement; no correction of that uncertain editorial placement is made from this nominal alone.

Political and legal uses are grouped under existing gewinnen rather than split into technical senses. The distinction from round-1 earning 1b is semantic: winning a lawsuit is not itself earning the fee.

Checked glossary_lookup searches fako, əšmo and ḥayṣ: no fixed ḥyṣl + daily bread/name idiom was established. No idiom is published merely from the nominal subsistence phrase or the ambiguous Istanbul compliment.
29/422 mḥaysənnanne: confirm s/ṣ spelling, l+n assimilation and person/patient segmentation; retain exact transcription.
69/123: is lə in balki lə mḥayṣannole negative or a transcription/particle issue? German is affirmative; do not quote it as a straightforward matched affirmative example.
94/502 mḥayṣlole: confirm Preterit agent/patient segmentation; distinguish the homographic Infectum object construction at 57/227.
116/5 mḥayṣelala and 112/198 mḥayṣelele: confirm double-l suffix segmentation and self-benefactive interpretation.
The inherited bare ḥiṣolo is filed in Detransitive Infinitiv without context; no supplied occurrence resolves whether that placement is intentional. Keep it pending editorial check.
At Jan 1.39/1704, is ar rayat the acquired object and lu Xalq the L-marked agent, or does the vote expression act as subject? Do not infer a causative win reading from the machine translation.
At Jan 2.10/2616, does mḥayṣela u əšmo mean acquire a reputation or deserve/live up to the name Istanbul? Establish the construction before entering an idiom.
At Jan 2.31/5061, identify actor, patient and referents of mḥayṣele hanək before assigning a figurative meaning.
Confirm Mḥayṣewole at Jan 2.7/1855 and whether ḥəyṣolo belongs in the inherited Detransitive Infinitiv box or an agent-oriented nominal section.
At Jan 1.45/1947, does mḥayṣalwo mean win selection/election or simply manage to obtain the council position? Keep it within 1 pending clarification.
Catching extends to a trap as subject, obtaining social relationships, and acquiring cities in a game. Cash merely obtained, rather than earned through labor or commerce, remains 1 (116/5).
Jan work, trade and fee contexts independently support round-1 earning subsense 1b; do not propose it again. Generic acquisition of wealth without explicit earning remains 1.

Existing gewinnen extends to electoral victory, securing representatives and winning lawsuits. Subjects include parties and participants, while object/agent relations in the votes clause at 1.39/1704 require checking.
Daily bread, abstract reputation, ordinary food and self-benefactive procurement extend the acquired participant. None alone proves a new numbered meaning or fixed idiom.
